The season began on 9 September 2011, and ended on 18 April 2012.{{cite web |title=Fixtures & Results |url=http://www.slstat.com/spl2011-2012en/champtable.php |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170927221127/http://www.slstat.com/spl2011-2012en/champtable.php |archive-date=27 September 2017 |url-status=dead}} [[Al Hilal SFC|Al-Hilal]] were the [[2010–11 Saudi Pro League|defending champions]].{{cite web |title= الهلال بطل دوري زين للمحترفين والاتفاق يرمي بالنصر الى المركز الخامس|url=http://www.slstat.com/spl2010-2011ar/news.php?id=382|archive-url = https://web.archive.org/web/20170929005740/http://www.slstat.com/spl2010-2011ar/news.php?id=382|archive-date = 2017-09-29}} The league was contested by the 12 teams from the [[2010–11 Saudi Pro League|2010–11 season]] as well as [[Al-Ansar FC (Medina)|Al-Ansar]] and [[Hajer FC|Hajer]], who joined as the promoted clubs from the [[2010–11 Saudi First Division|2010–11 First Division]]. They replace [[Al-Hazem F.C.|Al-Hazem]] and [[Al Wehda FC|Al-Wehda]] who were relegated to the [[2011–12 Saudi First Division|2011–12 First Division]]. On 14 April, [[Al Shabab FC (Riyadh)|Al-Shabab]] won their sixth league title on the final matchday after a 1–1 draw away to runners-up [[Al-Ahli Saudi FC|Al-Ahli]].{{cite web |title=الشباب بطلاً لدوري زين |url=https://www.aleqt.com/2012/04/14/article_646956.html}} Al-Shabab ended the season without a single defeat becoming the second team to ever do so in a 26-game league season and the third team overall. [[Al-Ansar FC (Medina)|Al-Ansar]] were the first team to be relegated following a 1–0 home defeat against [[Al Raed FC|Al-Raed]] on 31 March.{{cite web |title=لرائد يكتب صك هبوط الانصار |url=http://www.slstat.com/spl2011-2012ar/news.php?id=609|archive-url = https://web.archive.org/web/20170929010403/http://www.slstat.com/spl2011-2012ar/news.php?id=609|archive-date = 2017-09-29}} [[Al Qadsiah FC|Al-Qadsiah]] became the second and final team to be relegated following a 3–2 defeat away to [[Al-Nassr FC|Al-Nassr]] on 13 April.{{cite web |title=القادسية يلحق بالأنصار إلى دوري الأولى|url=http://www.slstat.com/spl2011-2012ar/news.php?id=621|archive-url = https://web.archive.org/web/20170929005036/http://www.slstat.com/spl2011-2012ar/news.php?id=621|archive-date = 2017-09-29}} ==Teams== Fourteen teams competed in the league – the twelve teams from the previous season and the two teams promoted from the [[2010–11 Saudi First Division|First Division]]. The promoted teams were [[Al-Ansar FC (Medina)|Al-Ansar]] (returning after an absence of six years) and [[Hajer FC|Hajer]] (returning after an absence of twelve years).
